source: 692 Death before Rebirth
target: 692 Mors ante Renascentiam

source: Appeared once more?
target: Iterum apparuit?

source: Lumian motioned for Lugano and the others to loosen their hold and inquired of Amandina, “Where is he?”
target: Lumian signa dedit Lugano aliisque ut tenentia solverent et Amandina interrogavit: “Ubi est ille?”

source: Amandina’s sky-blue eyes locked onto the entrance of the black ancient tomb situated at the terminus of the motionless river.
target: Amandinae oculi caerulei in limen sepulcri antiquati atri, quod in extremo fluminis immoti situm erat, fixi sunt.

source: He’s sitting cross-legged over there.
target: Ille ibi sedet, crura inter se complexa.

source: As the words left her lips, Amandina shut her eyes and turned away.
target: Dum verba ex labris eius effluabant, Amandina oculos clausit et se avertit.

source: Minuscule protrusions emerged from her previously flawless and supple skin, each on the cusp of rupturing and giving rise to something unknown.
target: Ex cute eius, quondam immaculata et mollis, minuta protuberantia emerserunt, quarum unaquaeque prope rupturam esset et aliquid ignotum gignere pararet.

source: This reaction stemmed from her glimpse of the phantasmal, stagnant river and the ashen-white goat adorned with a golden mask, grappling to traverse the shallow waters.
target: Haec reactio ortum habuit ex eius aspectu fluminis phantasmatici stagnantis et caprae cineris pallidae, aurea masca ornatae, quae tentabat per undas tenues transire.

source: The pallid goat’s limbs, devoid of all fur, were extensively decomposed, exuding a nauseating yellow pus that swiftly encroached upon the remainder of its body.
target: Membra caprae pallidae, omnibus pilis carentia, late corrupta erant, et nauseabunde flavo pus celeriter reliquam partem corporis eius infestabat.

source: Under the sway of the Symphony of Hatred, Reaza’s wan and frigid countenance surrendered its final vestige of color.
target: Sub imperio Symphoniae Odii, vultus Reaza languidus et frigidus ultimum vestigium coloris tradidit.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: The decay gradually consumed the back of his hand, neck, and cheeks, lending him the appearance of a long-deceased cadaver.
target: Corruptio paulatim consumpsit dorsum manuum, collum, et genae eius, efficiens ut speciem cadaveri longo mortuo imitarit.

source: This decelerated the deterioration afflicting the pale goat’s body.
target: Hoc retardavit progressionem putredinis in corpore caprae pallidae.

source: Concurrently, the still river conjured by the black ancient tomb grew ever more illusory, its breadth and depth visibly diminishing.
target: Simul, flumen immotum, per sepulcrum antiquatum nigrum evocatum, magis magisque in illusoriam formam veniebat, eius latitudo et profunditas manifeste minuuntur.

source: The rag doll, shrouded in a sinister Gothic gown, drifted onward once more, shadowing the retreating river of quietude.
target: Pupa pannosa, in vestitu Gothicum sinistro induta, iterum perrexit, flumen silentii recedentem sequens.

source: Abruptly, it pivoted to regard the green-eyed man composed of human flesh and blood, who, coincidentally, reciprocated its gaze.
target: Subito, illa versum fecit ut virum, qui oculis viridibus instructus erat et ex carne et sanguine humano constitutus, inspiceret, qui fortuito eius aspectum rediit.

source: Loathing, enmity, and lunacy erupted from the sinister cloth doll’s crimson eyes.
target: Odium, inimicitia, atque insanitas ex oculis rubrīs pupae sinistrae erupit.

source: Its black Gothic attire, ensnared by baleful vines, ruptured into myriad holes, scattering fabric shreds and leaving it in tatters.
target: Vestimenta Gothicum nigra, a vitibus maleficis capta, in innumerabilia foramina divisa sunt, panni particulas spargens et rem in laniis relinquens.

source: The green-eyed man in the dark gray suit seemed unscathed, yet as he advanced, he imprinted two footsteps saturated with vivid red blood, the aroma of sulfur swiftly dissipating.
target: Vir viridoculatus in habitu obscuro cinereo intemeratus videbatur, sed dum procedebat, duo vestigia graduum, vividis rubro sanguine saturata, imprimivit, et odor sulphuris celeriter evanuit.

source: One stride, two strides, three strides. Each step emblazoned bright red footprints, while dark fluid seeped from his human skin.
target: Unum gressum, duo gressus, tres gressus. Quisque passus vestigia rubra nitida signabat, simulque obscurum liquidum ex cute humana eius effluens apparuit.

source: Iveljsta Eggers at last recovered from the onslaught of emotions and cravings unleashed by the Symphony of Hatred.
target: Iveljsta Eggers tandem se recuperavit ex impetu passionum et desideriorum, quae per Symphoniam Odii revoluta erant.

source: He cast a glance at the tattered evil cloth doll and retrieved an object from his concealed pocket–a palm-sized puppet.
target: Aspectum iecit in laniatam pupam maleficam pannosam et ex sinu suo occulto rem extraxit—pupulum magnitudine palmae.

source: The puppet appeared to have been stitched together by a young child’s hand. Its limbs were askew, its legs reaching its posterior, and its visage daubed with red, yellow, and white pigments, evoking the image of a circus clown.
target: Pupulum videbatur manu pueri parvuli consitum esse. Membra eius inordinata erant, crura ad natim suum pertingebant, et vultus rubro, flavo, atque albo tinctus erat, efficiens imaginem scurrilis circensis.

source: Iveljsta infused the misshapen puppet with his spirituality.
target: Iveljsta spiritum suum infudit in pupulum deformem.

source: It shimmered into intangibility and vanished from his grasp, materializing within the dark brown eyes of the Eggers family scion before vaulting into the green orbs of the man clad in human skin.
target: Illud in inmaterialitatem micavit et ex manibus eius evanuit, manifestatum in oculis fusco-brunneis nepotis familiae Eggers, antequam in orbibus viridibus viri, ex carne constituti, delapsum est.

source: This caused the figure in the dark gray suit to stiffen and decelerate.
target: Hoc fecit ut figura in habitu obscuro cinereo rigidaretur et tardaretur.

source: Lumian dared not prolong his gaze and hastily averted his eyes.
target: Lumian non ausus est aspectum suum procrastinare et celeriter oculos avertit.

source: As Amandina closed her eyes and turned away, the minute protuberances adorning her skin receded.
target: Cum Amandina oculos clausit et se avertit, minuta protuberantia cutem eius ornantia recederunt.

source: Intrigued, she stole a glance at the monstrosity, suspected to be a Devil, hurtling towards the green-eyed man, seemingly on the precipice of succumbing to terror.
target: Intrigata, furtim oculus ad monstrum, suspicatum Diaboli esse, qui ad virum viridoculatum properabat, iecit.

source: She swiftly surveyed her environment.
target: Celeriter ambitum suum perspiciens.

source: Her eyes then fell upon the colossal Devil’s incomplete carcass sprawled on the ground and a charred bone flute that had tumbled beneath a palm tree.
target: Oculi eius deinde incidērunt in cadaver incompletum ingentis Diaboli, quod in terra iacebat, atque in flautam ossium combustam, quae sub palma cecidisset.

source: “There, there’s something over there,” she whispered, tugging at Lumian’s sleeve.
target: “Ecce, ecce aliquid illic,” susurravit, trahens manicam Lumiani.

source: Could it be a potent artifact discarded by a gravekeeper?
target: An nonne sit potentissimum artificium, ab sepulturario deiectum?

source: Lumian peered over and murmured to Amandina and the others, “Feign ignorance. Refrain from touching or even nearing it.”
target: Lumian aspiciebat super et murmuravit ad Amandina aliisque: “Simula ignorantiam. Nolite tangere aut appropinquare.”

source: He had purposely abandoned the Symphony of Hatred there, deferring its retrieval.
target: Ille Symphoniam Odii ibi proposito relicerat, recuperationem eius differens.

source: In such circumstances, wielding it anew was far more prone to endangering his allies than exploiting an adversary’s vulnerability. As a Reaper, he had no need to employ the Symphony of Hatred to pierce the target.
target: His condicionibus, eam iterum adhibere multo verius socios suos in discrimen adduceret quam hostis infirmitatem exploiteret; ut Messor, non opus habebat Symphoniam Odii ad hostem perforandum.

source: Thus, he feigned a lack of opportunity to reclaim it, hoping an enemy would attempt to turn it against him.
target: Ita simulavit carentiam opportunitatis id recuperandi, sperans hostem eam in se convertere conari.

source: If a similar scenario unfolded, Lumian and the three godhood items would be the sole survivors capable of weathering the ensuing cataclysm unleashed by the Symphony of Hatred. At that juncture, he would whisk Amandina and her companions away via teleportation. Upon later return, he anticipated discovering the enemies’ lifeless husks and acquiring fresh spoils of war.
target: Si similis casus eveniret, Lumian et tres res divinitatis soli superstes essent, capaces tolerare cataclysmum subsequens, quem Symphoniam Odii emitteret. Illo tempore Amandina atque comites eius per teleportationem abrepto abduceret; et postea hostium cadavera sine vita et nova praeda belli adipisci sperabat.

source: It was a trap he had laid in passing.
target: Erat insidiarum consilium, quod per transitum posuerat.

source: As Devajo, transformed into a colossal Devil, retreated to the proximity of the human-skinned man and drew near the ebbing river of silence, a short silhouette walked out from the forest trail–a boy of seven or eight years old, clad in endearing sleepwear and a nightcap. His yellow hair and countenance were begrimed, besmirched with grease, dregs, and blood.
target: Cum Devajo, in ingentem Diabolum conversus, ad proximam partem viri ex carne constituti recederet et ad flumen silentii decrescentem appropinquaret, ex semita silvestri brevis figura egreditur – puer annorum septem aut octo, in amoenis vestimentis somni ornatus et pileo nocturno indutus. Capilli eius flavi et vultus sordidi, uncto, limo atque sanguine tincti erant.

source: Catching sight of the boy, Lugano experienced a piercing agony in his absent right hand.
target: Puerum videns, Lugano acutum dolorem in deesse manu dextro sensit.

source: “Man… Man… Man….” He gnashed his teeth in dread.
target: “Homō… Homō… Homō…” dentes in metu contraxit.

source: Observing his abnormal reaction, Camus and the others inquired in astonishment, “What’s wrong?”
target: Observantibus reactionem eius insolitam, Camus aliisque mirati interrogaverunt: “Quid accidit?”

source: Tracing Lugano’s line of sight, Amandina, Camus, and Rhea spotted the boy.
target: Sequentes aspectum Luganoi, Amandina, Camus, et Rhea puerum animadvertērunt.

source: The former swiveled to Lumian in bewilderment, “Isn’t, isn’t that your godson? Why is he here? It’s very dangerous!”
target: Prima autem se ad Lumian vertit, attonita, “Nonne ille est filius spiritualis tui? Cur hic adest? Maxime periculosum est!”

source: “No, he’s not in danger.” Camus recollected Kolobo’s exaggerated reaction upon encountering Louis Berry and his godson. He recalled some of the words of his companion from the Fate pathway and said with a solemn expression, “We should be the ones in danger.”
target: “Non, non est in periculo.” Camus, meminens reactionem exagitaram Kolobo, cum Ludovico Berry atque filio spirituali eius occurrerent, verba aliqua socii sui ex via Fati recolens, graviter dixit: “Nos ipsi in periculo esse debemus.”

source: Without waiting for Amandina and Rhea’s misgivings, Camus regarded Lumian and knitted his brow.
target: Non exspectans dubitationes Amandinae et Rhea, Camus ad Lumian aspiciens, supercilium congregavit.

source: “What do we do?”
target: “Quid facimus?”

source: As a godfather, you should have a way to control your godson, right?
target: Ut padrinus, debet esse modus quo filium padrini tuum regas, nonne?

source: Lumian’s gaze flitted to Ludwig pursuing the Devil, then to the corpses and Hisoka’s Devil form strewn on the ground. He replied with a grin, “It’s not a big problem.”
target: Lumian oculos convertit ad Ludovicum, qui Diabolum insequebatur, deinde ad cadavera atque formam Diaboli Hisoka in terra dispersam; respondens cum risu, “Non est res magna.”

source: There was ample food here to form an effective seal!
target: Cibus hic satis abundabat ad sigillum efficax formandum!

source: As to why Ludwig had trekked to the black ancient tomb, Lumian roughly had an idea.
target: Quod attinet ad cur Ludwig ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum perveniret, Lumian aliquam ideam haberet.

source: The man and woman who had freshly arrived in Tizamo tonight and taken lodging at the Brieu Motel were likely minions of the Nois family’s Demon. By some means, they maintained lucidity in this special dream. Once the Dream Festival commenced, they left the motel and hastened towards the black ancient tomb.
target: Vir et femina, qui hac nocte nuper in Tizamo advenerant et in Brieu Motel hospitium ceperant, probabiliter ministri Daemoni familiae Nois erant. Aliqua ratione in hoc somnio speciali lucidi manebant. Postquam Festum Somniorum inceperunt, motel reliquerunt et festinanter ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pervenerunt.

source: During this process, they passed the second floor, inducing Ludwig to catch wind of delicacies. He forsook the insipid fare and shadowed them closely, matching the pace of a seven- or eight-year-old child.
target: Durante hoc processu, secum per tabulatum secundum transierunt, inducens Ludwig ut de deliciis suspiceret; cibum insipidum deseruit et eos arcte secutus est, aequales gressus pueri septem aut octo annorum habens.

source: At that moment, Ludwig’s brown eyes were fixed solely on Devajo, the Devil.
target: Illo momento, Ludovici oculi castanei solummodo in Devajo, Diabolo, intenti erant.

source: “Why isn’t it a big problem?” Amandina wore a look of skepticism.
target: “Cur non est res magna?” Amandina vultum dubitationis gerebat.

source: Lumian smiled and indicated the massive Devil who had fled in proximity to the green-eyed man.
target: Lumian subridet et monstrum ingentem Diaboli, quod prope virum viridoculatum fugit, significavit.

source: “He’s here to hunt down that monster.”
target: “Ille hic est ut illum monstrum venaretur.”

source: “Hunt? Him?” Amandina glanced left and right in confusion.
target: “Venari? Eum?” Amandina, sinistra ac dextra intuens, perplexa est.

source: A seven- or eight-year-old boy in azure star-spangled sleepwear, pursuing a pitch-black Devil almost three meters in height, with curved goat horns and bat wings sprouting from his back? This is indeed a dream, right?
target: Puer septem aut octo annorum in indumento somni caeruleo, stellis ornato, qui Diabolum atrum paene trium metrorum altitudinis, cum cornibus caprinae incurvis et alis vespertilionis e dorso emergentibus, insequitur? Hic certe somnium est, nonne?

source: As he neared the green-eyed man formed of human flesh and blood and the black ancient tomb, Devajo sensed a tinge of respite. Yet, his mind remained haunted by visions of his tongue roasting, his brain scooped out by a soup spoon, and his arms and legs gnawed by the boy.
target: Dum ad virum viridoculatum, ex carne et sanguine humano formatum, et ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum accedebat, Devajo paululum quietis sensum adeptus est. Attamen, mens eius manebat vexata visionibus linguae eius ardescens, cerebri eius cochleari suppae excavati, atque brachiorum et crurum eius a puero masticatorum.

source: What kind of monster is this? Devajo watched in abnormal fear as the boy strode towards him.
target: Qualis monstrum hoc est? Devajo, in metu insolito, puerum ad se pergentem observabat.

source: At that juncture, Amandina, who had stolen a glance their way, exclaimed, “That figure is looking at the man in the black robe.”
target: In illo momento, Amandina, quae furtim oculos in eorum partem iecisset, exclamavit: “Illa figura ad virum in veste nigra spectat.”

source: Iveljsta? Lumian peered over but discerned nothing amiss with Iveljsta Eggers.
target: Iveljsta? Lumian intueri conatus est, sed nihil in Iveljsta Eggers incommode observavit.

source: Amandina averted her gaze, taking a moment to regain her composure before looking again.
target: Amandina oculos avertit, aliquantum temporis recipiens ut se redintegraret, deinde iterum spectare incipiebat.

source: She quickly explained, “He’s not looking at the man in the black robe. He’s looking at the Devil!”
target: Celeriter enarravit: “Ille non aspicit virum in veste nigra; Diabolo aspicit!”

source: Amandina abruptly halted, withdrawing her gaze and furrowing her brow.
target: Amandina subito cessavit, oculos revocans et supercilium congregans.

source: “That figure seems to utter something… I don’t know the language, but I understand the meaning.”
target: “Illa figura aliquid verbi efferre videtur… linguam nescio, sed sensum intellego.”

source: “What did he say?” Lumian pressed.
target: “Quid dixit?” inquit Lumian.

source: Amandina dared not look towards the black tomb. She organized her thoughts and said,
target: Amandina non ausa est ad sepulcrum nigrum spectare. Cogitationes suas ordinavit et dixit:

source: **“Basically, it means:
target: “Praecipue, hoc significat:

source: “Everyone in the world knows that crawling insects can spin cocoons. After the cocoon fractures, butterflies take wing.
target: ‘Omnes in orbe terrarum sciunt insecta reptantia capsulas sericas texere posse. Postquam capsula dirimitur, papiliones evadunt.

source: A common insect can transform into a fluttering butterfly and alter its form of life. Why?””**
target: Insectum commune in papilionem volitantem se transformare potest atque formam vitae mutare. Cur?’”

source: Unknowingly, Amandina’s voice shifted, as if swayed by some influence.
target: Nesciente, vox Amandinae mutata est, quasi aliquo impetu commota.

source: She paused for a moment before answering the question in a low, cold voice, “Death before rebirth. Ascension into godhood…”
target: Aliquamdiu sistit, deinde quaestioni, voce humilis et frigida, respondit: “Mors ante renascentiam. Ascensus in deitatem…”

source: Before Amandina could finish her sentence, Devajo, in his Devil state, stiffened.
target: Antequam Amandina sententiam finire potuit, Devajo, in statu Diaboli, rigidatus est.

source: He beheld his flesh swiftly decaying, fragments sloughing off to bare ghastly white bones.
target: Vidit carnem suam celeriter putrescere, et fragmenta abscindebantur, revelantes ossa albissima et formidanda.

source: Within seconds, the Devil lost consciousness and crumbled into a mound of putrefying flesh and bones.
target: In paucis secundis, Diabolus sensum amisit atque in aggerem carnis putrescentis et ossium dissolutorum cecidit.

source: The remains fused as if alive, intertwining to form a human‑sized cocoon.
target: Reliquiae coalescebant, quasi vivae, implicantes se ad formandum capsulam hominis aequipollentem.

source: It rapidly shattered, and a human-headed avian monster draped in white plumage emerged.
target: Celeriter confracta est, et monstrum avium capite humano ornamentatum, alis albis indutum, emersit.

source: After absorbing all the flesh and blood, the monster expanded significantly, its form undergoing a transformation.
target: Postquam omnem carnem et sanguinem confudit, monstrum signanter expansum est, eius formaque mutationem passa est.

source: The lower portion of its head rapidly elongated and expanded, as if possessing a body of its own. The flesh at its “waist” melded with the avian body, mantled in pale‑yellow feathers.
target: Pars inferior capitis eius celeriter elongata est et expandit, quasi corpus proprium haberet. Carnis in zona lumborum eius cum corpore avium coalescebant, operta plumis pallido‑flavis.

source: “Hahaha!” Devajo, with innumerable white feathers sprouting from his eyes, nostrils, visage, and fingertips, erupted into laughter.
target: “Hahaha!” Devajo, cum innumerabilibus albis plumis ex oculis, naribus, vultu, et digitorum apicis emergentibus, in risum conflavit.

source: He slapped the white‑feathered bird body below and soared skyward, as if riding it.
target: Ipse corpus avis, plumis albis opertum, percussit et in caelum ascendit, quasi illud equitaret.

source: Devajo ascended higher and higher, gradually turning ethereal. Then he spiraled downward and entered the black ancient tomb.
target: Devajo altiora ascendit et paulatim in aethera se vertens; deinde, in gyrum decedens, intravit sepulcrum antiquum nigrum.

source: Witnessing this, Lumian glanced once more at the entrance of the black ancient tomb but still could not perceive the unseen figure Amandina had mentioned.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian iterum ad introitum sepulcri antiquati nigri aspiciebat, sed figuram invisam, quam Amandina commemoraverat, non possit percipi.

source: His heart stirred as he took two steps forward and retrieved the peculiar golden mask from Hisoka’s corpse.
target: Cor eius commotus, cum duo gressus progredieretur, larvam auream insolitam ex cadavro Hisoka extraxit.
